subject: exp-info-b
title: (R)EXP.INFO.B. ----LANG.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-34, second of two on book p276, paired with v2-p276-1. Continues the Japan analysis by holding experiential-information-basis at its real register against language-dynamics — language being the operational vehicle of culture-gap. (R)EXP-INFO-B (the reality of experiential information basis) is crossed with LANG-DY (language dynamics): the question is what experiential-information-basis produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with language-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that the actual Japanese creative experience exists (against Western denial), and language-dynamics is precisely what determines whether that experience can become internationally legible. (R)SG (reality of significance) sits at the upper-center. AFTD (affinity-tendency) anchors the upper-right output. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and C-CONT (composite continuance) form the right output cluster. LANG-DY appears a second time on the lower-left (Braxton's typographic double-naming when a node functions at two registers — as crossing-partner and as lower-cluster element). (P)POST (point-of-activation postulation), (R)STY (reality of style), and SOC (society) form the lower-center cluster. MT-INFO (multi-information) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) anchor the bottom. Structural argument: experiential-information-basis-as-real crossed with language-dynamics is mediated by reality-of-significance as central hub. The doubled LANG-DY exposes Braxton's structural commitment that language-dynamics functions at two simultaneous registers: as the crossing-partner (the structural axis) and as a lower-cluster element (the operational mechanism). The (p) prefix on postulation registers that under one-way culture-gap conditions, postulation about Japanese music operates only at point-of-activation — when individual Western listeners encounter the music — rather than as sustained institutional postulation, and the (r) prefix on style commits that real Japanese style actually obtains and can ground composite-continuance.
